title: Order No. U-37763 — Utility Order for Evangeline Gas Company, Inc., ex parte.
text:
Order No. U-37763
Page 1
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ORDER NUMBER U-37763
EVANGELINE GAS COMPANY, INC., EX PARTE.
Docket No. U-37763, In re: Request for an increase in rates, request for approval of rate
stabilization plan, and request of Commission's non-opposition for a loan and line of credit for
operating expenses. (This matter is being republished to provide notice of Evangeline’s amended
application, filed March 19, 2026, seeking the Commission’s non-opposition for a loan and line
of credit for operating expenses.)
(Decided at the June 17, 2026 Business and Executive Session.)
ORDER
I.
BACKGROUND
On October 21, 2025, Evangeline Gas Company, Inc, (“Evangeline” or “Company”) filed
its Request for an increase in rates and request for approval of rate stabilization plan.
(“Application”). Evangeline’s Application was published in the Commission’s Official Bulletin
No. 1361 dated October 24, 2025, with a fifteen-day intervention period. No interventions were
received.
On March 19, 2026, Evangeline filed an Unopposed Motion to Upset Procedural Schedule
to Allow for Supplemental Application and Supplemental Application for Non-Opposition
Authorizing Loan and Use of Line of Credit (“Supplemental Application”). Evangeline’s
Supplemental Application was published in the Commission’s Official Bulletin No. 1372
(Amended) dated March 27, 2026, with a fifteen-day intervention period. No new interventions
were received.
Staff reviewed Evangeline’s Application, Supplemental Application, supporting
testimony, and responses to formal data requests as requested by LPSC Staff. On May 22, 2025,
Staff filed the Direct Testimony of Chassitty J. Williams (“Direct Testimony”). In this Direct
Testimony, Staff detailed its review of Evangeline’s Applications and made corresponding
recommendations. On May 26, 2026, Evangeline filed Correspondence Accepting the LPSC
Staff's Report and Recommendation.
On May 28, 2026, the Parties subsequently entered into an Uncontested Stipulated
Settlement (“Settlement”). This executed Settlement was filed into the record, as part of the Joint
Motion for Scheduling of Hearing on Uncontested Stipulated Settlement Term Sheet (“Joint
Motion). A hearing on the Settlement was held on June 2, 2026.

II.
COMMISSION AUTHORITY
The Commission exercises jurisdiction in this proceeding pursuant to Article IV, Sec. 21
of the Louisiana Commission. 
La. Const. Art. IV. Sec. 21 provides in pertinent part:
The commission shall regulate all common carriers and public
utilities and have such other regulatory authority as provided by law.
It shall adopt and enforce reasonable rules, regulations and
procedures necessary for the discharge of its duties, and shall have
other powers and perform other duties as provided by law.
III.
STIPULATED SETTLEMENT
On May 28, 2026, Evangeline and Commission Staff, filed the Joint Motion, including
Uncontested Stipulated Settlement Term Sheet, Settlement Testimony from Chassitty Williams
for Staff, and Settlement Testimony from Bryan Savant on behalf of Evangeline. The Settlement
resolved all issues in this proceeding. Terms of the Stipulated Settlement are:
1.
Evangeline shall be authorized to increase its gas rates to generate an additional
$415,873.10 in revenue in accordance with the following rate design:
2.
Evangeline must provide written notice to its customers no later than fifteen (15)
days prior to implementing any new rates. Upon full compliance with this
provision, Evangeline shall provide to the Commission’s Utilities Division a copy
of the notice given to its ratepayers.
3.
Evangeline shall continue to file compliance reports, regarding progress made to
remedy any and all compliance issued cited by LDCE1, consistent to LPSC Order

4.
Within fifteen (15) days after the issuance of an order in this proceeding,
Evangeline must file in the record of this proceeding a new or revised tariff
reflecting the Commission’s action and submit a copy of the same to the
Commission’s Utilities Division.
5.
Evangeline is not authorized to create and implement a Rate Stabilization Plan.
6.
Staff recommends that the Commission express its Non-Opposition for Evangeline
to enter into a loan and line of credit for operating expenses filed as a part of its
Supplemental Application.
7.
Except as expressly stated herein, this Stipulated Settlement has no precedential
effect in any other proceeding and will be without prejudice to the right of any party
to take any position in future proceedings. The terms of this Stipulation may not be
used either as an admission of any sort or as evidence in any proceeding
whatsoever, except to approve or enforce the terms of this Stipulation. All oral or
written statements made during the course of settlement negotiations are governed
by Louisiana Code of Evidence Article 408.
8.
This Settlement shall in no way be considered or used as evidence or conclusory
determination of any current or future LPSC reviews or audits.
IV.
COMMISSION CONSIDERATION
This matter was considered at the Commission’s June 17, 2026 Business and Executive
Session. On motion of Chairman Skrmetta, seconded by Commissioner Lewis, with Commissioner
Francis concurring, Vice Chairman Coussan temporarily absent, and Commissioner Campbell
absent, the Commission voted to accept the Uncontested Stipulated Settlement filed into the record
on May 28, 2026.
Order No. U-37763
Page 4
IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED THAT:
1) The Uncontested Stipulated Settlement filed into the record on May 28, 2026, is accepted;
and
2) This order is effective immediately.
BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
July 9, 2026

synopsis: Order No. U-37763 accepts the Uncontested Stipulated Settlement filed into the record on May 28, 2026, which authorizes Evangeline Gas Company, Inc., to implement an increase in rates, and the Commission expresses its non-opposition to Evangeline Gas Company’s request to be authorized to enter into a loan and use a line of credit subject to the terms and conditions agreed to within. This matter was considered at the June 17, 2026 Business and Executive Session.
